```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(nlrFlow)
```

This reference vignette supplies a third documentation layer for public functions in the agronomy and physiology context. Heavy optional backends are shown with `eval=FALSE`.
```{r eval=FALSE}
# Public API coverage calls
f <- nl_fit(data=nl_data("okra_growth_means"),model="gompertz",response="fruit_length",predictor="day_after_flowering",engine="nls")
nl_audit(nl_data("okra_growth_means"),"fruit_length","day_after_flowering")
nl_models()
nl_model_info("gompertz")
nl_capabilities()
nl_data("soil_fertility_p")
nl_start(nl_data("okra_growth_means"),"fruit_length","day_after_flowering","gompertz")
nl_fit(data=nl_data("okra_growth_means"),model="gompertz",response="fruit_length",predictor="day_after_flowering",engine="nls")
nl_fit_many(nl_data("okra_growth_means"),"fruit_length","day_after_flowering",c("logistic","gompertz"),engine="nls")
nl_select(nl_fit_many(nl_data("okra_growth_means"),"fruit_length","day_after_flowering",c("logistic","gompertz"),engine="nls"))
nl_compare(nl_fit_many(nl_data("okra_growth_means"),"fruit_length","day_after_flowering",c("logistic","gompertz"),engine="nls"))
try(nl_lrt(f,f,nested=FALSE))
nl_cv(f,k=3)
nl_confint(f,"wald")
nl_boot(f,R=10)
nl_predict(f)
nl_diagnose(f)
nl_influence(f)
nl_identify(f)
nl_contrast(f,c(Asym=1,k=0,xmid=0))
nl_curve_test(f,f,FALSE)
nl_derive(f)
# nl_robust(formula,data,start)
# nl_quantile(formula,data,start,tau=.5)
# nl_mixed(model,data,fixed,random,start)
# nl_saemix(model_function,data,psi0,id,predictor,response,parameter_names)
# nl_bayes(brms_formula,data,prior)
# nl_ppcheck(bayes_fit)
nl_simulate("gompertz",1:10,c(Asym=18,k=.4,xmid=4))
# nl_plot(f)
# nl_plot_diagnostics(f)
nl_table(f,"parameters")
# nl_save_plot(plot,"figure.svg")
# nl_report(f,"report.md")
nl_teach("gompertz")
nl_tutor(FALSE)
nl_doctor()
```
